title: Evaluation
description: One execution of the central invariant: a function of FIVE pinned inputs (ADR-0021). Identity is the sha256 of all five, so a changed environment yields a distinct evaluation rather than a silently different score.

digest.description: sha256 over the five input digests below.

reproduction_class.description: EXACT: five inputs and platform match, bit-identical scores guaranteed. EQUIVALENT: platform differs, scores agree within the Protocol's tolerance. UNREPRODUCIBLE: any input unpinned — such an evaluation may not be published or persisted (ADR-0021, STD-21).

leakage_gate_applied.description: Whether the gate was enforceable. false where the Protocol sets requires_bitemporal = false, so a reader can see which guarantee was in force rather than assuming (ADR-0022).

interval.description: Required, not optional. A bare number without its uncertainty is the figure this platform exists to refuse (STD-05).

denominator.description: What the metric was computed over. A rate without its denominator cannot be weighed against another.
